units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:2">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>אין הנביא ר׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00217"><he>חָדַשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 7:5">Peah VII, 5</cite> <he>בשלו הוא ר׳ ואינו ר׳ וכ׳</he> he has power of disposal over that which belongs to him, but not over that which belongs to the poor.

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 8:4">Arakh. VIII, 4</cite> <he>אין אדם ר׳ להחרים וכ׳</he> no man has a right to vow &c., v. <cite ref="H01714"><he>חָרַם</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>רַשָּׁאִים</he>, <he>רַשָּׁאִין</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:8">Ab. IV, 8</cite> <he>אל תאמר קבלו דעתי שהן ר׳ וכ׳</he> say not (to your fellow judges) accept my opinion, for theirs is the power (as a majority), not thine.
B. Bath. 8ᵇ; a. fr.—Fem. רַשָּׁאָה.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 8:4">Tosef. Yeb. VIII, 4</cite> <he>האשה ר׳ שתינשא וכ׳</he> a woman is permitted to marry even a eunuch.
<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 8:7">Arakh. VIII, 7</cite> <he>אומדים … עולה שאינו ר׳</he> we estimate how much a man would pay for it to offer it as a burnt-offering which he is not bound to offer.
